title: ConnectionChoice
description: Represents an org-scoped SSO sign-in option shown during discovery. Local methods (passkey/password) are not listed here; see DiscoverVerifyResponse.localConnections.

type.description: SSO type. Context (org) comes from the parent membership.

connectionId.description: Connector identifier used by backend routes like /auth/oidc/start or /auth/saml/start.

startUrl.description: SP-initiated start URL (OIDC always; SAML when enabled).

idpInitiated.description: True when SAML IdP-initiated sign-in is allowed; users may start from the IdP portal.
